text: ZX Bank has established a robust and customer-focused branch network across Nepal, ensuring that both urban and semi-urban populations have easy access to modern banking services. With a strategic focus on digital onboarding, remittance corridors, and personalized service, ZX Bank's 20 branches are thoughtfully distributed across key provinces. This broad presence enables efficient banking experiences, remittances, and financial inclusion in all major regions of the country.
